note: Dated changes to places, each from an official notice. 'missed_by' lists other public sites that did not show the change when we checked (with the page we looked at). Add new items when the daily watcher (scripts/watch_places.py) flags a page.

items.title_en: Folk Museum: Permanent Exhibition Hall 1 closes for three months
items.detail_en: The rest of the museum stays open. Planned dates — check the notice before you go.

items.title_en: Chuseok: free entry at the 4 palaces and Jongmyo
items.detail_en: Changdeokgung Secret Garden is not included.

items.title_en: Free every Wednesday at Changdeokgung, Changgyeonggung and Jongmyo
items.detail_en: Starts 7 Oct 2026 (Changdeokgung Secret Garden not included). Deoksugung has been free on Wednesdays since 5 Aug. Gyeongbokgung stays free only on the last Wednesday of the month.

items.title_en: Gyeongbokgung: the stone terrace of Geunjeongjeon Hall is closed
items.detail_en: Closed to protect the stone railings. The rest of the palace is open.
19:00–21:30 (last entry 20:30). No night viewing on Mondays and Tuesdays.

items.title_en: Changgyeonggung: limited access to Munjeongjeon Hall
items.detail_en: Because of the 'Changgyeonggung Yayeon' event. No night viewing of this hall.

items.title_en: War Memorial closed on Tue 6 Oct
items.detail_en: The day after the substitute holiday. Open on Sat 3 Oct and Fri 9 Oct.

items.title_en: MMCA Seoul closed on Tue 1 Dec
National Museum: some galleries closed for renovation
items.detail_en: Buddhist Paintings (Room 203), Wood and Lacquer Crafts (Room 204), Calligraphy and Painting. The rest of the museum is open.

items.title_en: Seoul Museum of History open until 21:00
items.detail_en: Most days except Thursday, until 30 Nov.
